title: LLM Serving Market
blurb: The LLM serving market at level 0: inference compute enters through two interfaces that differ in what a sensor can see. A router splits routed workload between frontier serving and open-weight serving by the shares a router reports (OpenRouter via the Dirac digest, June–July 2026), and self-hosting reaches open-weight serving only, since closed weights cannot be self-hosted. Each serving subsystem turns allocated compute into served tokens — information out, every Gtok of work dissipated as heat, as a GPU does — and each decomposes into a child holding its roster of models behind a pool; zoom into a subsystem to see it, or double-click to enter. The forcing series drives the routed interface; the self-hosted workload stays at the model's declared placeholder, grounded unknown, until a sensor exists.
